jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer - Backend** to build and scale our real-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault-tolerant, high-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms.

A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Scale the real-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high-throughput, low-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes.
* Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores.
* Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes.
* Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments.
* Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low-latency queries.
* Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers.
* Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers.
* Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks.
* Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of backend engineering experience building production-grade services and microservices.
* 2+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6+ (C#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components.
* 2+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo).
* Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns.
* Resilience and fault-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
* Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers.
* Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside.
* Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams.

**Nice-to-have**
----------------

* Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge).
* Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints).
* Experience with dual-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases.

**About LakeFusion**
--------------------

LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

**About the role**
------------------

LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer - Backend** to build and scale our real-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault-tolerant, high-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms.

A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Scale the real-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high-throughput, low-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes.
* Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores.
* Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes.
* Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments.
* Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low-latency queries.
* Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers.
* Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers.
* Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks.
* Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of backend engineering experience building production-grade services and microservices.
* 2+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6+ (C#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components.
* 2+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo).
* Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns.
* Resilience and fault-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
* Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers.
* Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside.
* Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams.

**Nice-to-have**
----------------

* Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge).
* Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints).
* Experience with dual-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases.

LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

Nous déterminons l’échelle salariale de base de ce poste selon votre lieu de travail principal :

* **Zone B :** salaire brut de 89 800 $ CA à 134 800 $ CA

Parsec creates ultra-low latency, high-performance remote desktop technology that empowers creative professionals to work from anywhere, businesses to embrace flexible workplaces, and individuals to play together from anywhere. * Be fascinated with building cutting edge technology in gaming from video rendering to UDP protocols
* Be obsessed with finding the right, low latency solution to the challenges we face
* Listen to customer feedback, interpret the needs of the broader community, and find opportunities to delight our customers

* Familiarity with Windows desktop application development
* A deep desire to learn, improve a product, and make customers happy
* Experience working with a globally distributed team

**Internal Applications & Development**

At Leap Tools, we are building the world's most advanced solutions for the interior décor industry. With customers in 80+ countries, our clientele includes Fortune 500 companies such as Home Depot, local retailers such as Alexanian's, and everything in between. We have been recognized as one of the fastest-growing tech companies by Deloitte for multiple years in a row, and we are looking for ambitious challenge-seekers to fuel our momentum and help us create an iconic global tech company.

**About our Product**

Our technology lets you preview products in your own room before you buy them. Imagine you want to redesign your home and have been searching for new tiles for your kitchen, or a new rug for your living room. You definitely want to make sure it will look good in your space. We enable you to do that through our proprietary cutting-edge technology, presented in an extraordinarily simple and accessible way. Try our rug demo now! Simply upload a picture of your room using your mobile phone, and slide the rug under your coffee table: https://www.roomvo.com/rugdemo...

Behind the visualizer sits a second product line: **QFloors**, the business management platform that flooring dealers run their companies on, from leads and quotes through invoicing, purchasing, accounting, and payroll. Today it is a Windows desktop application delivered through the cloud, and we are moving it, domain by domain, onto a modern web ERP that is part of the Roomvo Pro platform. Dealers, suppliers, and manufacturers meet on that platform, and that is where our next stage of growth comes from.

**About the Role**

You will build features that move dealers off the desktop application to the modern web ERP. You will work across the backend and the frontend of the modern web ERP, from the database to the screen, inside designs set with senior engineers. When legacy behaviour is unclear, you will read the legacy desktop code to find out what it really does.

**About you**

You have a passion for solving complex problems and working on products that businesses run on every day. You enjoy setting the bar high and clearing it.

You have shipped real features to real users, and you can take a well-defined piece of work from a ticket to production with little hand-holding. You ask for help early when something is ambiguous, and you call out trade-offs nobody mentioned. You want to grow into owning bigger pieces of the system, and you learn fast from the people around you.

We hire humans, not job descriptions. You should apply even if this role and salary range don't align with your experience. We’re happy to create unique roles and compensation for the right talent.

**About our Stack**

* **ERP backend**: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS
* **ERP frontend**: Next.js, TypeScript, React
* **QFloors Desktop**: C++ on Windows, PostgreSQL, Azure

**What You'll Do:**

* Build features end-to-end across the ERP service and the web ERP: Django models and APIs, and the Next.js screens that use them.
* Break well-defined work down into steps, deliver it, and raise the trade-offs you see along the way.
* Write correct models and database migrations that respect tenant isolation and row-level security.
* Read the desktop codebase to understand legacy behaviour before rebuilding it.
* Ship with tests, watch your releases in production, and fix what breaks.
* Give solid code reviews in your area, and learn from the reviews you get.
* Keep your lead and your team informed with clear status, and flag risks early.
* Learn from senior engineers, and help the more junior ones.

**We’re looking for someone with:**

* 2+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong computer science fundamentals based on a degree in computer science or distinctive work experience in software development.
* Experience building backend services and APIs, and some front-end experience.
* A good understanding of relational databases and SQL.
* Strong focus on execution and delivery of the product.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with a focus on quality and long-term goals.
* Strong communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where learning and adaptability are key

**Preferred, not required:**

* Experience with Python and Django, and with Next.js or React.
* Experience with ERP, accounting, or other business management software.
* Some exposure to C++ or other compiled language.

**About our culture**

* We're a remote-first company that encourages our employees to work from where they're most productive.
* We work in tight-knit teams to cultivate an ownership mentality.
* We cherish curiosity and an obsession for details because we know these details are invaluable over the long run.
* We're hyper-focused on our achievements and our ability to execute our promises. We act with urgency.
